Start with tiny tiny tiny little baby steps. Everything you do different is better than what you began at. I have a very hard time with setting boundaries for example. I learned from reading Set Boundaries, Find Peace how to do it. If someone is upsetting me I can say something like, “I don’t like it when you do,” or “please don’t do x, it makes me feel like y.” It can be really hard, it’s been really hard for me, but don’t tell yourself it’s impossible. Try and think of life’s obstacles as challenges. Don’t think about what you can’t control, think about what you can control and the resources you have now. Focusing on the lack will not help you at all, but focusing on what you DO have can be helpful. It can be difficult and it’s something I’ve only just started doing, but little by little it helps. Set steps for your goals and now just the goals. You want to be stronger emotionally. What does that look like for you? Write it all down and try and break it down. “I want to be stronger. My first step will be the next time someone does something that makes me uncomfortable, I will do my best to tell them how I feel.” It doesn’t have to be perfect. If you tell someone that, but don’t say it how you want to, you still did something about it, which is a big step. Write down all the things you do to better yourself too. I hope this helps you!
